**Finding: LICENSE — compliant (preferred position met).**

The Section 13 grant already delivers every preferred element:

- **Affiliates and contractors:** §13.1 grants access rights to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," with Authorized Users permitted — no written-notice gate needed, so the fallback mechanic is unnecessary.
- **Paid-up perpetual and irrevocable:** §13.2 grants Customer and its Affiliates a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence," extended by §14.3 to Vendor Technology required to use a Deliverable.
- **Subscription licence revocable only for uncured material breach:** §13.3 permits revocation or suspension only "during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure."
- **Transferable to successors:** §13.3 read with §24.1 (assignment to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor's consent) and §24.4 (no Vendor termination, suspension, or repricing on Customer change of control).

The §13.4 restrictions are narrow and expressly do not limit authorized security testing or use of Customer Data and output, so they do not erode the grant. No redline proposed.
